description: This file defines the 'Unpacker' class responsible for unpacking package dependencies within a Drupal Composer plugin, including updating composer.json and composer.lock files, processing dependencies, and managing package states.

classes.name: Unpacker
classes.description: Final readonly class responsible for unpacking package dependencies, updating composer.json and lock files, and managing package states within a Drupal Composer plugin.

methods.name: unpackDependencies
methods.description: Unpacks the package's dependencies to the root composer.json and lock file.

methods.name: processPackageDependencies
methods.description: Processes dependencies of the package, adding recipes to the unpack collection or yielding links.

methods.name: updateComposerJsonPackages
methods.description: Updates the composer.json content by adding dependencies and removing the unpacked package.

methods.name: updateComposerLockContent
methods.description: Removes the unpacked package from composer.lock and updates local repository state.

methods.name: getPackageFromLinkTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a package object from a link target using the local repository.
